protocol:
NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly Reaction (E2621). 
Set up the following reaction on ice (to 20μl total volume): Recommended Amount of Fragments Used for Assembly2–3 Fragment Assembly*4–6 Fragment Assembly**Positive Control✝Recommended DNA Ratiovector:insert = 1:2vector:insert = 1:1 Total Amount of Fragments0.03–0.2 pmols*X μl0.2–0.5 pmols**X μl10 μlNEBuilderHiFi DNA Assembly Master Mix10 μl10 μl10 μlDeionized H2O10-X μl10-X μl0Total Volume20 μl✝✝20 μl✝✝20 μl. 
Incubate samples in a thermocycler at 50°C for 15 minutes (when 2 or 3 fragments are being assembled) or 60 minutes (when 4–6 fragments are being assembled).
Following incubation, store samples on ice or at –20°C for subsequent transformation.
Transform NEB 5-alpha Competent E. coli cells (provided in the cloning kit or purchased separately from NEB) with 2 μl of the assembled product, following the transformation protocol.

script:
# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
pipette(container='reaction tube', reagent='DNA fragments (vector and insert)', volume='X μl (to achieve 0.03–0.2 pmols for 2–3 fragments or 0.2–0.5 pmols for 4–6 fragments)', temperature='on ice', ratio='vector:insert = 1:2 (2–3 fragments), 1:1 (4–6 fragments)')
pipette(container='reaction tube', reagent='NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly Master Mix', volume='10 μl', temperature='on ice')
pipette(container='reaction tube', reagent='Deionized H2O', volume='10-X μl (for 2–6 fragment assembly), 0 μl (for positive control)', temperature='on ice')
mix(container='reaction tube', volume='20 μl total', temperature='on ice')
incubate(container='reaction tube', reagent='assembled reaction', volume='20 μl', temperature='50°C (2–3 fragments) or 50°C/60°C (4–6 fragments)', duration='15 minutes (2–3 fragments) or 60 minutes (4–6 fragments)', device='thermocycler')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: store (container: reaction tube, reagent: assembled reaction, volume: 20 μl, temperature: on ice or –20°C, other: {'purpose': 'subsequent transformation'})
# MANUAL: transform (container: transformation tube, reagent: NEB 5-alpha Competent E. coli cells, assembled product, volume: 2 μl (assembled product), other: {'protocol': 'transformation protocol'})
